examples.title: Example 1: Opening Nested Dialog Boxes
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to open one or more custom dialog boxes within another custom dialog box.

examples.title: Example 2: Opening a Dialog Box Outside the Main Window
examples.description: When showInSubWindow is set to true on a 2-in-1 device, a pop-up window can be displayed outside the main window.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Dialog Box Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set styles of a custom dialog box, including the width, height, background color, and shadow.

examples.title: Example 4: Configuring a Dialog Box in the Hover State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the layout area of a dialog box in hover mode on a foldable device.

examples.title: Example 5: Obtaining the Dialog Box State
examples.description:
This example shows how to call the getState API in CustomDialogController to obtain the current status of the dialog.
The getState API is added to CustomDialogController since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 6: Using @Link and @Consume to Listen for Data Changes
examples.description: This example uses @Link and @Consume to implement bidirectional data binding between the page and the dialog box.

examples.title: Example 7: Customizing a Loading Dialog Box
examples.description: In this example, maskColor, maskRect, and LoadingProgress are used to implement a dialog with loading and display the transparent transmission effect of events that are not in the maskRect area.

examples.title: Example 8: Adjusting Dialog Box Spacing from the Soft Keyboard Without keyboardAvoidDistance
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to listen for keyboard changes and adjust the bottom of margin to achieve the same effect as using keyboardAvoidDistance to adjust the spacing between the dialog box and the soft keyboard.
Starting from API version 15, the keyboardAvoidDistance attribute is added to CustomDialogControllerOptions.

examples.title: Example 9: Using Dialog Box Lifecycle Callbacks
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to configure the lifecycle callbacks for the dialog box.
In API version 19, the onDidAppear, onDidDisappear, onWillAppear, and onWillDisappear attributes are added to CustomDialogControllerOptions.

examples.title: Example 10: Implementing Dialog Boxes with Different customStyle Values
examples.description: This example shows the effect of the dialog box content and safe area when the alignment mode is DialogAlignment.Bottom and the value of customStyle is different.

examples.title: Example 11: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description:
This example describes how to customize the background blur effect by configuring the backgroundBlurStyleOptions.
In API version 19, the backgroundBlurStyleOptions attribute is added to CustomDialogControllerOptions.

examples.title: Example 12: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description:
This example shows how to customize the background effect by configuring backgroundEffect.
In API version 19, the backgroundEffect attribute is added to CustomDialogControllerOptions.

examples.title: Example 13: Dynamically Updating the Custom Dialog Box Width
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to dynamically update the custom dialog box width by synchronizing the custom component's width with a state variable.
